plain_english_policy: If enacted, this bill would propose a constitutional amendment that permanently bans counties and municipalities in Alabama from imposing new occupational taxes on individuals after January 1, 2010. The policy direction is to restrict local government revenue sources by prohibiting future levies based on gross receipts derived from vocations or professions.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Prohibition of Future Local Occupational Taxes
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced a measure to restrict local taxation authority regarding occupational taxes.
evidence_quotes: "to prohibit the imposition of an occupational tax by a county or a municipality after January 1, 2010."

(a) After January 1, 2010, no county or municipality may impose a privilege or license tax on the gross receipts of any natural person derived from the conduct of a vocation, occupation, calling, or profession within the county or municipality.
